name: MLVU
intro: MLVU是一个多任务长视频理解基准，旨在全面深入评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在长视频理解（LVU）任务中的性能。它通过显著扩展视频长度、包含多样化的视频类型（如电影、监控录像、自我中心视频、卡通、游戏视频等）以及开发多样化的评估任务来解决现有基准的局限性。对23个最新MLLMs的实证研究表明，现有技术在处理长视频时仍有显著提升空间，且在大多数评估任务中表现不佳。MLVU有望通过对MLLMs的全面深入分析，推动长视频理解领域的研究进展。
org: BAAI, BUPT, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Zhejiang University, Peking University
build_method: 人工标注、官方数据集标签改编、GPT-4辅助生成、探针视频合成
metric: 七类选择题任务准确率与不加权宏平均M-Avg；GPT-4双维度生成评分与不加权宏平均G-Avg
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
eval_feature: 零样本长视频推理与任务级宏平均
scale: 论文v3：1,730个视频、3,102个问题（开发2,593/测试509）；当前测试扩展为588题
build_method_en: Human annotation, official-dataset label adaptation, GPT-4-assisted generation, and probe-video synthesis
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot long-video inference and task-level macro averages
intro_en: MLVU is a multi-task long video understanding benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on long video understanding (LVU) tasks. It addresses the limitations of existing benchmarks by significantly extending video length, including diverse video types (such as movies, surveillance footage, egocentric videos, cartoons, game videos, etc.), and developing a variety of evaluation tasks. An empirical study of 23 state-of-the-art MLLMs shows that current techniques still have substantial room for improvement in handling long videos and perform poorly on most evaluation tasks. MLVU aims to advance research in long video understanding through comprehensive and in-depth analysis of MLLMs.

drawio_review_note: Verified against arXiv:2406.04264v3 (2025-01-01; PDF SHA-256 653b5ca6a2c2c1f6ab2b4ee5033d1c9194897a968c6f304ad55a6b5d6e52d06f), Sections 3.1–4.1 and Appendices C–G; the official repository paper-data commit 4bcc3c01d56db14a26a1efd8bb5caa2c496454d6, dev-data tree 4a16523b21784de0f83b32796612e3a58a7de8f2, evaluation tree 10b31fa1a363116ed42c466f7a2fa5e3786412c9, contemporaneous snapshot ee8ac0984f7cdfc53730a0aecde5c7ce457570fd, and current main bc1a68d1efbcdb949a20a83677e1e8b4ec9f3e79; and Hugging Face dev/test revisions 06ddc388aa34746b3abba77972b7a7dfd977f7a3 and dc6616b28cc1d5a20b26a5d8db7c76b2361b107d. Paper v3 constructs the 986-video ULVC from 168 movies, 60 documentaries, 65 game videos, 239 surveillance videos, 100 egocentric videos, 72 cartoons, 92 TV-series videos, 60 tutorials, 60 sports videos, and 70 life records. Final benchmark videos are selected, edited, or synthesized from ULVC; one source may be used whole, clipped, or reused as a synthetic background, so no unreported one-to-one 986-to-1,730 algorithm is implied. The diagrams preserve all paper-v3 task totals and routes: TR 355 human theme MCQs; AR 239 UCF-Crime-label adaptations from videos longer than 3 minutes, with no manual annotation reported; VS 257 human visual-only chronological summaries from 3–15 minute videos; NQA 415 WebVid/Clevrer needles with GPT-4-assisted QA and checked ULVC backgrounds; ER 405 Ego4D-NLQ adaptations; PQA 589 human unique-plot QA; SSC 247 Movie101 prompts, captions, and nonredundant scoring points; AO 329 and AC 266 synthetic action-probe tasks from Kinetics/ActivityNet-Caption plus ULVC backgrounds. Task QC includes ordered visual-only VS summaries without character names, unique PQA/SSC clues without direct plot hints, absence checks for the NQA scene and AO/AC action in the original background, and SSC scoring points that do not repeat prompt details. The paper-v3 contract is 1,730 videos and 3,102 questions split into 2,593 dev and 509 test items; dev MCQs have four options and paper-v3 test MCQs have six. The paper does not disclose split randomization, seed, video/source disjointness, annotator count/agreement/rejection rates, an item-level ULVC transformation manifest, a deduplication/contamination scan, or full Clevrer/ER/GPT-4-NQA construction parameters. The pinned repository dev JSON contains exactly 2,593 records: MCQ fields video, duration, question, candidates, answer, question_type; SSC adds scoring_points; VS omits candidates and scoring_points. It has no question_id, needle/probe time, full provenance, annotator, or QC fields. Test labels were hidden only in the contemporaneous paper-era repository snapshot; current ground truth was released on 2025-03-18. The current Hugging Face cards mark the data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, video/test payloads remain auto-gated, and copyrighted video availability can change. The later official test adds Sports QA and Tutorial QA, yielding 11 tasks and 588 test items (502 MCQ plus 86 generation), or 3,181 dev-plus-test questions; this drift is a dashed audit card and is not merged into the paper-v3 nine-task/509-test totals. Evaluation is zero-shot through official implementations/APIs with model-specific uniform-frame or fps sampling rather than a universal frame budget. MCQ outputs are exact-matched to gold options. The paper tables and released task-level code support, but the paper does not explicitly print, M-Avg as the unweighted macro mean of seven task accuracies and G-Avg as the unweighted mean of SSC and VS task scores. SSC uses Accuracy plus Relevance, each 1–5; VS uses Completeness plus Reliability, each 1–5. Figure 8 also labels the VS second criterion Correctness, while released code uses score_reliability. Released judge code uses gpt-4-turbo at temperature 0, a code fact not stated as the paper-wide judge configuration. The paper omits a universal inference seed/full decoding setup, repeats, variance, and invalid-output policy; choice_bench.py is a template with undefined pred, generation scripts rely on fragile text lookup, and no combined G-Avg script is released. Source-only verification: the bilingual specs are structurally isomorphic, use numeric 10pt node-label overrides, and temporary Draw.io plus desktop-PNG builds both exited 0 with XML validation passed. The validator reported 26 non-blocking density and label-length diagnostics per language; no formal .drawio/.arch.json/.svg/.png asset was regenerated in this source-only change. Temporary 1785×2005 originals and 0.9× 1607×1805 previews were inspected without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings. Formal publication evidence [site-a11l-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1765×1985 (English) and 1765×1985 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1763×1983 and 1763×1983. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
